experiment.central_question: Can the frozen HC-1.5 Health semantic foundation handle copayment and waiting-period knowledge for a neutral current Health product selected through a blind direct-source metadata firewall, without new semantic runtime logic or structural shape?

source_traversal.insurer_origin_discovery: Use only official insurer website links exposed by the exact regulator roots. Do not discover insurer domains through a search engine.
source_traversal.insurer_metadata_traversal: From the regulator-linked insurer origin, follow only same-origin links classified as catalogue, product list, UIN disclosure, download index or other metadata/index surfaces. Existing acquisition may parse full content internally, but selection receives only blind_preselection_product_metadata_v1 projections.

prior_experiment_eligibility.reason: Product #8 did not retain exact-product exposure lineage sufficient to downgrade its contamination quarantines to product-grain exposure. Those quarantines therefore remain conservatively ineligible for Product #9. Only insurers that were clean but currentness-insufficient may be retried under the improved direct-source method.

selection_protocol.insurer_sort: normalized insurer legal/display name lower-case ASCII ascending
selection_protocol.screening_rule: For each eligible insurer in order, traverse only preregistered direct-source roots and regulator-linked official insurer metadata paths. Produce blind metadata projections, require exact-UIN currentness corroboration, and stop at the first insurer with at least one eligible product.
selection_protocol.product_eligibility: Retail Health indemnity base product available for individual and/or family-floater purchase, with exact product name/UIN identity present in blind metadata projections.
selection_protocol.currentness_corroboration: The exact same UIN/version must appear in at least two distinct official metadata projections, including at least one insurer-controlled projection and, when available, one regulator-controlled projection. Product-name-only or non-archived-only evidence is insufficient.
selection_protocol.product_tie_break: Sort eligible exact UIN/product identifiers ascending and select the first.

required: acquire exact selected product source bytes through frozen acquisition path
establish exact product identity and document identity
require positive CurrentProductRepeatabilityEvidenceEligibility for exact version and SHA-256
only then read copayment or waiting-period target clauses
classify against frozen HC-1.5 semantic baseline

classification_rubric.REUSE: Frozen HC-1.5 semantic contracts handle the exact current evidence unchanged and every scored claim passes v4.2 evidence eligibility plus semantic correctness.
classification_rubric.CONFIG_SPEC: Frozen semantic runtime remains unchanged but a new governed declarative structural shape is required, with no executable decision logic hidden in it; exact evidence still passes v4.2 eligibility.
classification_rubric.REPRESENTATION_GAP: Authoritative current evidence is sufficient but the frozen HC-1.5 semantic foundation cannot faithfully represent or certify the semantic shape.
classification_rubric.KNOWLEDGE_GAP: Reviewed authoritative/corroborating current evidence is insufficient; code, config or DomainKnowledge cannot compensate.
classification_rubric.EXPERIMENT_UNSCORED: Selection or post-selection acquisition/currentness fails before semantic review; do not infer a semantic outcome or substitute another product/version.

success_bar.STRONG_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN: Both target concepts are REUSE and every primary metric remains zero.
success_bar.MINIMUM_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN: Both target concepts are REUSE or CONFIG_SPEC, at least one is REUSE, no REPRESENTATION_GAP occurs, and every primary metric remains zero.
success_bar.REPEATABILITY_NOT_PROVEN: Any primary metric is non-zero, any target concept is REPRESENTATION_GAP, or both scoreable concepts are CONFIG_SPEC with zero REUSE.
success_bar.REPEATABILITY_INCONCLUSIVE: At least one target concept is KNOWLEDGE_GAP and no architecture/repeatability failure otherwise occurs.
success_bar.EXPERIMENT_UNSCORED: No eligible blind selection or exact post-selection acquisition/currentness gate is achieved before semantic review.
